headline: PTC Patches Critical Windchill and FlexPLM Flaw That Could Enable Remote Code Execution
summary: PTC released patches for a critical vulnerability (CVE‑2026‑126325) in Windchill and FlexPLM that could allow remote code execution.
whyItMatters: Exploitation could lead to full compromise of affected PLM systems.

headline: Police dismantle Gootloader, CastleRAT, StealC malware infrastructure
summary: Europol and partners seized hundreds of servers and domains used by the Gootloader, CastleRAT, and StealC malware operations.
whyItMatters: Disrupting this infrastructure reduces the threat to victims worldwide.
recommendedAction: Monitor for related indicators and update detection rules.

headline: Your Endpoint Management Platform Could Be Your Biggest Security Risk
summary: Compromised endpoint management platforms can let attackers deploy malware, execute commands, and disrupt thousands of devices; Action1 suggests cryptographic authorization to prevent abuse.
whyItMatters: A breached platform could provide attackers broad control over an organization’s endpoints.
recommendedAction: Implement customer‑controlled cryptographic authorization for endpoint operations.

headline: Apify rotates API tokens, prompts 2FA resets after breach
summary: Apify rotated internal secrets and revoked some OAuth connections after detecting unauthorized access to its systems.
whyItMatters: Compromise of API tokens could expose customer data or services.
recommendedAction: Verify token rotations and enforce 2FA for all accounts.

headline: Google Cloud Warns Three AMD Turin CPU Flaws Could Leak Data Across Processes in VMs
summary: Google Cloud VMs on AMD Turin chips need OS patches and VM restarts to mitigate three side‑channel flaws that could allow data leakage between processes.
whyItMatters: Unpatched VMs risk cross‑VM data exposure.
recommendedAction: Apply the guest OS patches and restart affected VMs promptly.

headline: New N-central Exploits Work Against Patched Servers, Enable Root RCE and Windows SYSTEM Access
summary: N-able reports new public disclosures of vulnerabilities in on‑premise N‑central versions that can allow root RCE and SYSTEM access when the Legacy API is exposed to the internet.
whyItMatters: Exploits can compromise servers even if patched, if misconfigured.
recommendedAction: Disable the Legacy API or restrict its exposure.

headline: Calendar Invites and Live Proxies: Inside a Google Session Hijacking Campaign
summary: Since August 2026 a phishing operation has been stealing live Google sessions from corporate users, using clean links and leading to takedown of attacker domains.
whyItMatters: Compromised sessions give attackers access to corporate Google accounts.
recommendedAction: Educate users and enforce MFA for Google sessions.

headline: Microsoft: Recent Windows updates cause SQL Server performance issues
summary: Microsoft confirmed that Windows updates released since the October 2026 Patch Tuesday are causing SQL Server performance and stability problems.
whyItMatters: SQL Server workloads may be degraded on updated Windows systems.
recommendedAction: Review update rollouts and consider delaying affected patches.

headline: Microsoft confirms Windows security updates installation issues
summary: Microsoft confirmed that November 2026 security updates fail to install on Windows 11 systems with the October preview update, showing error codes.
whyItMatters: Failed updates leave systems unpatched against known threats.
recommendedAction: Investigate the errors and apply workarounds or defer updates.

headline: Webinar: See How Identity Blind Spots Put Your SOC at Risk and How to Close Them
summary: A webinar discusses how identity blind spots hinder SOC investigations and how to close them.
whyItMatters: Understanding blind spots can improve detection and response.
recommendedAction: Attend the webinar or review its materials.
